subject.title: [Bug]: Notarized macOS app auto-terminates ~0.5s after launch (no menu-bar icon) in remote mode — macOS 26

question: Should maintainers run a notarized macOS 26 remote-mode launch reproduction before allowing this issue to close or move into an automated fix lane?
rationale: The source path and reporter logs are strong enough to keep the issue open, but the remaining root cause may be signing, Sparkle, AppKit lifecycle, packaging, or status-item ownership and needs a real notarized build proof path.

options.title: Run notarized reproduction
options.body: Test v2026.6.11 or current main as an official notarized app on macOS 26 in remote mode before scoping any fix.

options.title: Wait for reporter refresh
options.body: Leave the issue open but require the reporter to confirm the latest notarized release still exits before maintainers spend release-machine time.

options.title: Close only with release proof
options.body: Close as implemented only if maintainers can show the latest notarized release stays resident and shows exactly one menu-bar icon in the reported remote-mode setup.

recommendation.title: Run notarized reproduction
recommendation.body: Test v2026.6.11 or current main as an official notarized app on macOS 26 in remote mode before scoping any fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They posted landing proof for the closest merged menu-bar PR and have recent history on the macOS app lifecycle surface.
